Add a question to a survey spec

Source: R/spec.R
add_question.Rd

The order of the add_question() calls is the order of the survey. The package builds the extraction schema from answer and valid: one LLM call extracts the answer and checks it. If the answer is not valid, the survey asks again, up to tries times (see set_config()).

Usage

add_question(spec, id, text, answer, valid = NULL, intro = NULL)

Arguments

spec

A survey spec from survey_spec().

id

The question id. It is the name of the extracted field and the question_id in the database. It must be a syntactic name.

text

The question as a string, or a prompt_llm() for an adaptive question that the LLM writes from the earlier answers.

answer

A scalar ellmer type, such as ellmer::type_string(), that describes the answer to extract.

valid

The condition for a valid answer, written without TRUE or FALSE, such as "they mentioned any flavor". If NULL, the question uses the default from set_config() at the time of this call.

intro

An optional prompt_llm() with a format. The LLM generates content that the survey shows before the question.

Value

spec with the question added at the end.

Placeholders

text, the prompts, and the format of intro can use {id} placeholders for the answers to earlier questions. A placeholder that does not name an earlier question gives a warning, because the user would see the raw name.

Examples

survey_spec() |>
  add_question(
    "flavor",
    text = "What's your favorite ice cream flavor?",
    answer = ellmer::type_string("The ice cream flavor"),
    valid = "they mentioned any flavor"
  ) |>
  add_question(
    "why",
    text = "What makes {flavor} your favorite?",
    intro = prompt_llm(
      "Share a short fun fact about {flavor} ice cream.",
      format = "Oh, {flavor}! {content}"
    ),
    answer = ellmer::type_string("The reason they like it")
  ) |>
  add_question(
    "follow_up",
    text = prompt_llm(
      "The user likes {flavor} because: {why}. Ask one follow-up question."
    ),
    answer = ellmer::type_string("The answer to the follow-up question")
  )
#> <surveychat_spec> version "1.0", 3 questions
#> 1. flavor [own rule]
#> 2. why [intro]
#> 3. follow_up [adaptive]
